name: be-cross-border
description: Belgian cross-border tax for 2026: who is a Belgian tax resident (home or seat of wealth, the National Register presumption, and the company test of main establishment or seat of management); arriving under the special tax regime for inbound taxpayers and researchers (35% cost allowance, EUR 70,000 minimum pay, changed by the law of 18 December 2025); non-resident income tax (belasting der niet-inwoners, BNI) and the 75% rule; the new 10% exit tax on financial assets from 1 January 2026 and the company exit charge on moving the seat abroad, with EU/EEA deferral; 30% withholding tax on outbound dividends, interest and royalties; treaty relief and EU social security coordination. Tax year 2026 (assessment year 2027). Trigger on: moving to Belgium, leaving Belgium, expat Belgium, impatriate, BBIB, BBIO, non-resident Belgium, BNI, exit tax Belgium, roerende voorheffing non-resident, digital nomad Belgium. Out of scope: be-income-tax, be-social-contributions, belgium-payroll, be-capital-gai
